APPLIED ML / ENGINEERING PROJECT

Phishing Detection Classifier

Inspect suspicious content through an ML lens.

A portfolio project exploring phishing classification with lexical features, NLP, and gradient-boosted models.

XGBoostNLPScikit-learnPython

01 / THE PROBLEM

Why build it?

Suspicious URLs and messages contain signals that can be represented as features, but false positives and evolving attacks complicate classification.

02 / THE IMPLEMENTATION

How it fits together.

Shakeel’s portfolio describes a classifier using lexical analysis, feature extraction, and XGBoost to identify phishing-related content. The project combines text-oriented features with a supervised classification workflow.

  • Lexical feature extraction
  • NLP-oriented content analysis
  • Gradient-boosted classification
